stem: \[2x + y = 11\] \[x + y = 7\] If \((x, y)\) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Subtract the second equation from the first: \((2x + y) - (x + y) = 11 - 7\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sol = solve([2*x + y - 11, x + y - 7], [x, y])
assert sol == {x: 4, y: 3}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[x]]
